task: Core #1186 U10A2-F2: append-only customer baseline 0048 scoped delegation v2 with forward-compatible chain tests

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Tenant-scoped SQL authorization in SECURITY DEFINER and browser RLS can leak staff data or break Team Chat after migrations; require negative/positive state matrices, SQL syntax and real target proof.

acceptanceCriteria: 0048 body is byte-for-byte canonical scoped delegation source with recorded digest
0047 foundation exists earlier and defines store_delegations and original evaluate_store_capability_v1
Permission/delegation upgrade DDL, private scoped helper and v2 RPC preserve canonical names and grants
Baseline guard passes 49 migrations in snapshot-reviewed, freshInstallProofRequired true and hash null
No customer/Alap/Team Chat privilege broadening or unproven production/fresh acceptance
Existing 0047 provenance test must remain valid when 0048 and later migrations are appended
invariants: Existing U10A2 F1 foundation commit is unchanged
Store-team capability resolver authority comes exclusively from canonical source
Real DB role and Fresh Install acceptance is required before merging SQL chain
Alap base support and transactional email continue independent of Team Chat Pro
forbiddenStates: Original scoped delegation source silently diverges
Manifest flips to ready without fresh proof
Authenticated receives unexpected grant from the baseline copy
U10A1 deployed ahead of 0049+ privacy dependencies

failureModes: Scoped delegation column not present before v2 helper references it
Store delegation rule weakening from incorrect source copy
Existing legacy function signature remains after 0048
Silent RLS or service_role grant loss
Source hash copied without checking actual body
Fresh Install proof hash incorrectly reused
Merged baseline missing complete Office chain
Wrong release base includes earlier high-risk migrations
edgeCases: Old legacy v1 RPC callable by service role

alternatives.summary: Append the unchanged scoped delegation v2 main SQL as 0048, with SHA256 and source ordering proof.
alternatives.reason: Preserves the canonical permission model while keeping 5/5 release scope isolated.

alternatives.summary: Rewrite scoped evaluation locally inside customer baseline.

specialistReviews.finding: A copied v2 helper could still bypass browser RLS or actor checks when running under service_role.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep source-only status, preserve grant/revoke and require later live actor-scoped security proof before DONE.

specialistReviews.finding: Scoped delegation depends on columns and tables established by canonical 0047.
specialistReviews.resolution: Prove migration file ordering and exact byte identity; never rewrite historic files.

specialistReviews.finding: Database-schema patch high risk must stand alone.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only new 0048 and evidence-neutral test and plan, 5/5 risk.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing staging tenant schema lacks the latest Office privacy migrations and F2 source-only evidence cannot be production proof.
specialistReviews.resolution: No schema writes, no merged runtime and no changes to live project status before real clean-target acceptance.

challenge.scenario: A 0048 source migration runs without the 0047 store_delegations table being available.
challenge.finding: The alter table statements cannot execute and the customer bootstrap stops before creating its permission evaluator.
challenge.resolution: Require 0047 filename, source hash and foundation signatures in regression tests, and retain real replay as an explicit blocker.

challenge.scenario: A scoped delegation authorizer reads wrong organization context after a clone.
challenge.finding: A delegate could obtain rights in another tenant without intended owner authorization or could be blocked erroneously.
challenge.resolution: Preserve every canonical tenant/organization scope predicate byte-for-byte and prove read-path roles in disposable PostgreSQL.

challenge.scenario: A v2 source evaluator is modified locally to simplify permissions.
challenge.finding: A parallel authorization rule would bypass canonical source grants and earlier PO capability invariants.
challenge.resolution: Compare source SHA256 and complete SQL body exactly, rejecting mismatched or truncated migration contents.

challenge.scenario: The v2 source includes a grant to a broader role than intended.
challenge.finding: An incorrectly edited customer baseline could expose privileged delegation methods to anon or authenticated Data API roles.
challenge.resolution: Verify canonical source revoke/grant statements and use real RLS/GRANT role tests before target rollout.

challenge.scenario: A customer baseline is called ready immediately after adding v2 scoped delegation.
challenge.finding: The manifest may retain stale proof and mislead CI into believing later Office privacy/RPC migrations have run.
challenge.resolution: Keep snapshot-reviewed state with freshInstallProofRequired true and null proof hash until full clean replay.

challenge.scenario: An F2 commit changes 0047 or earlier SQL while adding 0048.
challenge.finding: The foundational migration provenance and role mappings become invalid and release risk isolation is broken.
challenge.resolution: Assert immutable 0047 hash and limit diff to F2 migration, neutral test and governance plan.

challenge.scenario: A legacy v1 function remains unexpectedly available to server-side service_role.
challenge.finding: The runtime may call the wrong function signature or use old delegation rules despite adding v2.
challenge.resolution: Record canonical function signature behavior and require future service-role runtime and negative actor tests.

challenge.scenario: A deployment migrates occupied staging that lacks prerequisite Office tables.
challenge.finding: The DB may reject or partially execute the chain, leaving platform and runtime semantics misaligned.
challenge.resolution: Keep current work source-only and mandate migration-ledger reconciliation plus disposable Fresh Install first.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Customer Fresh Install now has a source-reviewed Team Permissions foundation 0047 but the canonical main migration 20260907205500 scoped delegation v2 changes permission delegation columns, helper functions and evaluate_store_capability_v1 semantics. Without this ordered patch, later Digital Office privacy calls a stale role delegation authority and loses cross-tenant/scope hardening. The source must be preserved in an append-only 0048 without modifying any real Supabase database.
